title: Star Search

reward.description: A chart of ten thousand stars, sorted by brightness. You can find any of them in fourteen glances.

hints: Keep two indexes, lo and hi. Look at the middle: mid = (lo + hi) // 2. If the target is bigger, search the right half (lo = mid + 1); if smaller, the left half (hi = mid - 1).
count_checks is the same loop as binary_search, with a counter that goes up each time you look at stars[mid].
first_at_least: keep lo = 0 and hi = len(stars). While lo < hi: if stars[mid] < value, lo = mid + 1, else hi = mid. Return lo.
